name: editorial-baseline-v1
editorialInvariants: anticipate a causally linked transient surface so its opener remains visible
wait for factual cursor entry before tightening onto an outside-triggered sustained surface
hold the parent shot when a nested surface is already comfortably framed
reframe a nested surface when the parent cannot show it readably and safely
return cleanly when a foreground lifecycle ends
never invent support for an invisible or abstained surface
